newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Dec 18 coffee auction to total 90,018 bags.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Dec 18 coffee auction to total 90,018 bags.

text.p: The Brazilian government will auction 90,018 60-kg bags of coffee stocks in its next monthly auction on December 18, a Banco do Brasil official said.
The auction will be the largest so far in a series of monthly sales planned for this coffee year (July/June).
In November, the government sold 63,084 60-kg bags of coffee or 73.81 percent of its auction of 85,466 bags of stocks.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
